access: Fully open, GraphQL API, no key
control_KIF1A: pLI 1; LOEUF 0.2587 (3rd percentile); oe_lof 0.2023; obs/exp lof 46/227.34; lof_z 10.203; mis_z 6.868; oe_mis 0.6770
interpretation: KIF13A is strongly LoF-intolerant but only modestly missense-constrained, and is clearly less constrained than KIF1A on every axis. State this honestly: whole-gene missense constraint does not by itself support a missense-dominant model; motor-domain-local constraint is the relevant test and is not measured by these gene-level numbers.
caveat: GRCh37 returns the v2.1.1 numbers instead (pLI 0.99999, LOEUF 0.232, obs/exp lof 15/99.7, mis_z 2.047). The pLI 1.00 quoted in PMID 34303382 is the v2 value. The API carries no release string, so 'v4.x' is certain but the exact point release is UNVERIFIED. Phenotype-free by design.

access: Open browser, no login, no fee; REST backend under /api unauthenticated
kif13a_result: Present in the 500k WGS (v2), 460k WGS and 460k WES datasets, NOT in the 470k (v5) exome dataset. 500k WGS v2 (484,111 genomes, 15,129 phenotypes, 11 collapsing models): 21,887 gene-phenotype results, minimum p = 2.576e-05 (model flexdmg, continuous, '25845 Volume of grey matter in Cuneal Cortex (right)', n=179). Second 2.654e-05 (mean OD cingulum cingulate gyrus, n=44). Results with p < 1e-8: ZERO. p < 2e-9: ZERO. 470k v5: 2,697 results, minimum p = 3.684e-05, zero below 1e-8
control_KIF1A: 500k WGS: 18,776 results, minimum p = 1.603e-06 (flexdmg, continuous, diastolic blood pressure, n=431,938). Also zero below 1e-8
interpretation: Top hits are tiny-n brain-imaging phenotypes (n=179, n=44). Treat as noise.
caveat: TRAP: comma-joining multiple collapsing_model_ids silently returns 'Associations were not found', which reads like a real negative. Query one model id at a time. The study-wide threshold is not exposed in the portal; the published AZ threshold is p < 1e-8 (Wang et al. Nature 2021) but that is UNVERIFIED from the portal itself. No bulk summary-statistics download was found.

kif13a_result: 623 associated diseases, but by datatype: animal_model 541, literature 43, genetic_association 41, rna_expression 5. Maximum overall association score only 0.286 (glomerulonephritis). KEY NEGATIVE: of 525 credible sets linked to KIF13A, studyType counts are eqtl 343, tuqtl 130, sqtl 49, sceqtl 3, and GWAS = 0. Not one GWAS credible set is assigned to KIF13A. L2G evidence exists for 13 disease rows and NONE is neurological (top: glomerulonephritis 0.773, breast adenosis 0.726, lagophthalmos 0.709, liver disorder 0.705)
interpretation: The only neurological genetic association is ClinVar-derived, not population evidence: RCV003311600 / rs2532452593, score 0.32, mapped to apraxia, speech apraxia, seizure, moderate intellectual disability and Chiari malformation. That is VCV002570672 (see the leads table).
caveat: The 181 'neuro' diseases in the association list are overwhelmingly mouse eye and retina animal_model entries (Leber congenital amaurosis 0.061, retinitis pigmentosa 0.056). Do NOT present these as human genetic evidence.

access: Open, no key; use /singleNucleotidePolymorphisms/search/findByGene (the /genes/{symbol} route 404s); rate-limits with HTTP 429
kif13a_result: findByGene returns 93 unique SNPs but only 41 have distance 0 to KIF13A. Genuine in-gene-body associations by p: TPMT protein levels rs562345710 4e-20 (PMID 39789286); SCARA5 protein levels rs112683346 5e-15; TPMT protein levels rs748954374 5e-14; circulating SCARA5 rs570304138 1e-13 and rs536447969 2e-12 (PMID 42097137); lung function FEV1/FVC rs1014146 2e-11 (PMID 30595370); aortic stenosis rs6942390 6e-10 OR 1.05 (PMID 41419686); SULCAL DEPTH rs75428660 1e-09 beta 6.09 z (PMID 34910505, N=33,748); COPD rs62398171 2e-09 (PMID 37069358); CORTICAL THICKNESS rs75428660 5e-09 beta 5.85 z (PMID 34910505) and 2e-08 (PMID 34560273, N=35,657); BMI-adjusted waist circumference rs75964046 3e-08; height rs3734232 (splice_region) 3e-08. Sub-threshold: progressive supranuclear palsy rs4712314 p=2e-07 beta 0.27 (PMID 39152475, 1,718 cases / 2,944 controls)
interpretation: The only genome-wide-significant neurological signal is common-variant brain morphology at rs75428660 (intronic, chr6:17,885,814, distance 0 confirmed), replicated across two independent brain-imaging GWAS.
caveat: CRITICAL: 52 of the 93 SNPs are nearest-gene or within-100kb mappings, many at chr6:18.10-18.12 Mb, OUTSIDE the KIF13A body (17,759,183-17,987,635) and inside the TPMT region. The headline 'aging' and thiopurine hits (p to 4e-54) belong to that flanking region, NOT to KIF13A. Also, GWAS Catalog reports gene mapping not causal assignment, and Open Targets assigns no GWAS credible set to KIF13A, so even rs75428660 is positional and not L2G-supported.
